messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

As a basic principle, ACME AG receives invoices on paper or fax. These are received by the Secretariat in the central inbox and forwarded after a short visual inspection to an accounting employee. In `` ACME Financial Accounting ``, a software specially developed for the ACME AG, she identifies the charging suppliers and creates a new instance (invoice). She then checks the invoice items and notes the corresponding cost center at the ACME AG and the related cost center managers for each position on a separate form (`` docket ``). The docket and the copy of the invoice go to the internal mail together and are sent to the first cost center manager to the list. He reviews the content for accuracy after receiving the copy of the invoice. Should everything be in order, he notes his code one on the docket (`` accurate position - AP ``) and returns the copy of the invoice to the internal mail. From it, the copy of the invoice is passed on to the next cost center manager, based on the docket, or if all items are marked correct, sent back to accounting. Therefore, the copy of invoice and the docket gradually move through the hands of all cost center managers until all positions are marked as completely accurate. However, if inconsistencies exist, e.g. because the ordered product is not of the expected quantity or quality, the cost center manager rejects the AP with a note and explanatory statement on the docket, and the copy of the invoice is sent back to accounting directly. Based on the statements of the cost center managers, she will proceede with the clarification with the vendor, but, if necessary, she consults the cost center managers by telephone or e-mail again. When all inconsistencies are resolved, the copy of the invoice is sent to the cost center managers again, and the process continues. After all invoice items are AP, the accounting employee forwards the copy of the invoice to the commercial manager. He makes the commercial audit and issues the approval for payment. If the bill amount exceeds EUR 20, the Board wants to check it again (4 - eyes-principle). The copy of the invoice including the docket moves back to the accounting employee in the appropriate signature file. Should there be a complaint during the commercial audit, it will be resolved by the accounting employee with the supplier. After the commercial audit is successfully completed, the accounting employee gives payment instructions and closes the instance in `` ACME financial accounting ``.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_InvoiceProcess"
                  targetNamespace="http://bpmn.org/schema/bpmn"
                  exporter="Camunda Modeler"
                  exporterVersion="5.0.0">

  <!-- Collaboration defining the pools and lanes -->
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_01">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ACME" name="ACME AG - Invoice Processing" processRef="Process_InvoiceProcessing" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Main Process Definition -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_InvoiceProcessing" isExecutable="true">
    
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_01">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Secretariat" name="Secretariat">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_InvoiceReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_VisualInspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Accounting" name="Accounting Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IdentifySupplier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckPositionsCreateDocket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MoreManagers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ClarifyInconsistencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CommercialAuditResolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ResolveCommercialComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BoardCheckNeeded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GivePaymentInstructions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_InvoiceProcessed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CostCenterManager" name="Cost Center Manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewPosition</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ContentAccurate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApprovePosition</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RejectPosition</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeAfterApproval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CommercialManager" name="Commercial Manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CommercialAudit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CommercialAuditOK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Board" name="Board">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BoardApproval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Data Objects -->
    <bpmn:dataObject id="DataObject_Invoice" name="Invoice Copy" />
    <bpmn:dataObject id="DataObject_Docket" name="Docket" />

    <!-- Process Flow Nodes -->
    
    <!-- Secretariat -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_InvoiceReceived" name="Invoice received (paper/fax)">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_VisualInspection" name="Perform visual inspection and forward">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- Accounting -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_IdentifySupplier" name="Identify supplier and create invoice instance in ACME Financial Accounting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckPositionsCreateDocket" name="Check invoice items and create docket with cost centers/managers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreManagers" name="More cost center managers to review?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LoopNextManager</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToNextManager</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AllManagersApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Cost Center Manager -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewPosition" name="Review invoice position content for accuracy">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToNextManager</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ResendToCCM</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ContentAccurate" name="Content accurate?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ContentOK</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ContentInaccurate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApprovePosition" name="Note code (AP) on docket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ContentOK</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RejectPosition" name="Reject AP with note & statement on docket, send directly to accounting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ContentInaccurate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeAfterApproval">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LoopNextManager</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Inconsistency Loop back at Accounting -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClarifyInconsistencies" name="Clarify inconsistencies with vendor and/or CCM">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ResendToCCM</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- Commercial Manager -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CommercialAudit" name="Perform commercial audit and issue payment approval">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AllManagersApproved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CommercialAuditOK" name="Commercial audit successful?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AuditPassed</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AuditFailed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ResolveCommercialComplaint" name="Resolve complaint with supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AuditFailed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CommercialAuditResolution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AuditPassed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Board Review -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BoardCheckNeeded" name="Bill amount > 20 EUR?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BoardCheckYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BoardCheckNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BoardApproval" name="Check invoice (4-eyes-principle)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BoardCheckYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- Final Execution -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GivePaymentInstructions" name="Give payment instructions and close instance in ACME Financial Accounting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BoardCheckNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_InvoiceProcessed" name="Invoice processing completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_InvoiceReceived" targetRef="Task_VisualInspection" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_VisualInspection" targetRef="Task_IdentifySupplier" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_IdentifySupplier" targetRef="Task_CheckPositionsCreateDocket" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CheckPositionsCreateDocket" targetRef="Gateway_MoreManagers" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToNextManager" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreManagers" targetRef="Task_ReviewPosition" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_ReviewPosition" targetRef="Gateway_ContentAccurate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContentOK" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ContentAccurate" targetRef="Task_ApprovePosition" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContentInaccurate" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ContentAccurate" targetRef="Task_RejectPosition" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_ApprovePosition" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAfterApproval" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoopNextManager" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAfterApproval" targetRef="Gateway_MoreManagers" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_RejectPosition" targetRef="Task_ClarifyInconsistencies" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResendToCCM" name="Resolved" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyInconsistencies" targetRef="Task_ReviewPosition" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllManagersApproved" name="No (All positions AP)" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreManagers" targetRef="Task_CommercialAudit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_CommercialAudit" targetRef="Gateway_CommercialAuditOK" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_ResolveCommercialComplaint" targetRef="Gateway_CommercialAuditResolution" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_CommercialAuditResolution" targetRef="Gateway_BoardCheckNeeded" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_BoardApproval" targetRef="Task_GivePaymentInstructions" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_GivePaymentInstructions" targetRef="End_InvoiceProcessed" />
